subject: Literature
title: The Ramayana and Dharmic Duty
description: Learn The Ramayana and Dharmic Duty in one minute.

hook.text: The Ramayana tells of a prince who sacrifices everything, including his throne, to fulfill his sacred duty.

buildup.text: Rama is exiled for fourteen years, his wife Sita is kidnapped by a demon king, and he wages war to save her.

discovery.text: The epic has been retold across Southeast Asia from Indonesia to Thailand, each culture adding its own version.

twist.text: After rescuing Sita, Rama doubts her purity and banishes her, raising painful questions about heroism and justice.

climax.text: The Ramayana taught billions of people about dharma, or the tension between duty and personal desire.

punchline.text: The hero's hardest battle was between duty and love.

quiz.question: What moral concept does the Ramayana primarily teach?
options: Dharma, the tension between duty and personal desire
The supremacy of romantic love over all obligations
